verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native export feature. The only route out is the Public API, which can read tasks, comments and views and has an OpenAPI spec, so a user could extract data programmatically as a workaround. The import tools (Asana, Jira) bring data in and do not help a user leave. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-workspace export, export in open formats (CSV/JSON/Markdown) for tasks, docs, chat and attachments, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete export and exit is possible.
